April 1, 2025

# `draftOrderCount` available in 2025-07

DateApril 1, 2025

Version[2025-07](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-07)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

The [`draftOrderCount`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/queries/draftOrderCount) query is now available in the 2025-07 stable version of the GraphQL Admin API. Previously, it was only available in the `unstable` version.
